project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-155 Route Contract & Mount Honesty (Remediation Chain Night 1, stacked on PRD-154)
description: Branch from ralph/prd-154-wave0-quick-wins tip (PRD-153 honesty rule: if the base is incomplete, acceptance FAILS — no shims). Builds the net that protects every later PRD: CI fails when the frontend calls a non-existent backend path, boot fails loudly on router mount failure, and every registered tool must resolve to a live route. Full spec docs/PRDS/PRD-155-ROUTE-CONTRACT-MOUNT-HONESTY.md; chain policy docs/PRDS/PRD-CHAIN-2026-06-REMEDIATION.md.

userStories.title: Backend route manifest generator
userStories.description: Script/pytest fixture imports the FastAPI app and dumps sorted {method, path} pairs to reports/route-manifest.json deterministically. If app import currently opens DB connections at import time, make those lazy — the manifest must generate without Postgres.
acceptanceCriteria: python -m scripts.dump_routes produces a stable sorted manifest twice in a row (diff empty) — DONE: test_route_manifest.py::test_dump_routes_deterministic_two_runs asserts byte-identical; acceptance S1 check diffs two runs (742 routes)

Generation works with no DB available (test) — DONE: subprocess runs with POSTGRES_PORT=59432 (unreachable); create_engine lazy + lifespan-only init means import never dials DB; test_dump_routes_generates_without_db green
cd orchestrator && pytest -q green — DONE: 2142 passed, 17 skipped, 1 xfailed, 0 failed (no DB, integration skips cleanly)

userStories.title: Frontend path extraction + contract test
userStories.description: Static extractor over lib/api-client.ts, hooks/, and any remaining raw fetch: template literals like `${id}` normalize to path-param wildcards. Vitest contract suite asserts extracted paths ⊆ manifest (method-aware where extractable). NO allowlist/suppression file — anything failing on the PRD-154 tip is a real bug: fix the caller or delete it in this story.
acceptanceCriteria: Negative fixture: fabricated path fails the suite
Suite green on the PRD-154 tip with zero suppressions
npm run test:contract wired into package.json

userStories.title: Startup mount assertions replace silent try/except
userStories.description: main.py mounts ~25 routers inside try/except that swallows ImportError — two imports ALREADY fail silently every boot (main.py:115,123). Replace with an explicit expected-router manifest; boot raises naming the failed router. Escape hatch ALLOW_DEGRADED_BOOT=true via config.py (default off). Fix or deliberately delete the two currently-failing imports and record which in the PR description.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulated router ImportError fails startup with router name in message (test) — DONE: test_router_mount_manifest.py::test_required_router_failure_raises_naming_the_router asserts RouterMountError names the failed router + mentions ALLOW_DEGRADED_BOOT; test_allow_degraded_boot_downgrades_required_failure covers the escape hatch

Zero try/except ImportError around router mounts in main.py (grep gate) — DONE: `grep -nE "except[[:space:]]+ImportError" orchestrator/main.py` returns zero matches (was 28); 24 conditional routers moved to router_manifest.MANIFEST_ROUTERS, mounted via mount_manifest_routers(); widget middleware + 6 mount-time blocks converted to plain imports

The two failing imports resolved (fixed or deleted, documented) — DONE: api.auth and api.evaluation both DELETED (neither api/auth.py nor api/evaluation.py exists on disk — they failed ImportError every boot and mounted nothing); import + `if x_router` mount + manifest entry all removed

cd orchestrator && pytest -q green — DONE: 2148 passed, 17 skipped, 1 xfailed, 0 failed (+6 loader tests); route-manifest.json byte-identical (742 routes) proving the route SET is unchanged — only the mount mechanism changed; manifest still generates DB-free

userStories.title: Tool reachability test
userStories.description: For every action in the platform tool registry, assert a route exists in unified_executor.tool_routes and the dispatch layer resolves a handler (no LLM, no external calls). This kills the stale-tool-name drift class (e.g. workspace_file_read vs workspace_read_file) permanently.
acceptanceCriteria: Test enumerates the live registry; an injected stale name fails with a diff-style message

userStories.title: CI wiring for contract + reachability
userStories.description: Add both suites to .github/workflows/test.yml using the existing Postgres-service + per-test-timeout pattern. Non-required initially (PRD-142 Wave-2 test-net precedent); note the flip-to-required as a repo-admin follow-up in the workflow comment header.

Workflow comment documents the non-required rationale + flip plan
